inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-built: 10y CGB ~1.8% risk-free, China ERP ~7.25%, levered beta ~1.2 (property-linked building materials, high gearing) -> cost of equity ~10.5%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~3.8% (FY2025 finance costs 686 on ~18bn debt), ~2.9% after tax. Target D/V 35% (market-value D/V is ~60% at today's depressed price; using it would understate WACC) -> 7.8%, rounded to 8.0%. Same WACC in all scenarios: property-cycle, credit and governance risk are charged in the bear path and weights, not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB517m (75.8 current + 441.3 non-current) are inside total_debt and net_debt; lease principal (FY2025 RMB118m) is NOT deducted from flows; EBITDA is post-IFRS-16; right-of-use renewal (FY2025 additions RMB27m) is carried in the capex path. lease_cost_pct_path left at 0.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100% of subsidiaries); NCI charged once by deducting the NCI book stock (RMB465.9m at 30 Jun 2026) in equity_bridge. NCI share of profit is negative (loss-making non-wholly-owned subsidiaries), so the book deduction is the conservative choice.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, leases as debt, NCI in bridge, SBC-zero, non-operating assets in bridge). China Lesso is an operating manufacturer (plastic pipes ~86% of revenue), not a bank/REIT/holdco, so it routes to owner-FCF; its large non-operating balance sheet (investment properties, listed associates, financial assets) is handled sum-of-parts through equity_bridge, with the matching income stripped from the EBITDA anchor. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry, no prior DCF). EBITDA ANCHOR: company EBITDA (PBT + finance costs + D&A) includes share of associates/JVs, interest income, FVTPL gains, investment-property FV changes and goodwill/associate impairments. Operating EBITDA FY2025 = 3,948 - 91 (associates+JV) - 151 (interest income) - 197 (FVTPL gain) + 98 (IP FV loss) + 199 (goodwill 125 / associate 26 / held-for-sale 48 impairments) = ~3,806 (15.7%); H1 FY2026 ~1,915 (16.1%) vs H1 FY2025 ~2,269 (18.2%); H2 is seasonally weaker (H2 FY2025 ~13.0%), so FY2026 is set at 14.5%. Receivable impairments (RMB260m FY2025) and properties-from-settlement impairments are kept IN EBITDA as a recurring credit cost of selling to developers/contractors. CAPEX is net of PP&E disposal proceeds (FY2025: 2,097 gross + 27 ROU - 650 proceeds = 1,474, 6.1% of revenue); investment-property development spend (FY2025 125) is excluded from flows because IP sits in the bridge at a 50% haircut, which covers remaining development cost. NET DEBT is the latest (30 Jun 2026) balance sheet, 13,416. Because year 1 is full-year FY2026 starting from the FY2025 base, the H1 FY2026 increase in net debt (13,416 - 11,572 = 1,844, mostly a seasonal contract-liability/receivables build) would be counted twice -- once in the June net debt and again in the year-1 flow -- so it is added back in equity_bridge; the 2025 final dividend (RMB538m, declared, ex-date June 2026, unpaid at 30 June) is deducted. Net effect: Dec-2025 net debt plus the dividend owed to holders before today's ex-div price. Year 1 (FY2026) is discounted a full year although only ~2.5 months remain -- a small conservatism. Buybacks: none since FY2019 (RMB85m); flat count is a modelling convention, not a funded one, but with SBC nil it costs nothing. Weights tilted to bear (30/50/20): see weights_rationale.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue path (judgment); equity CAGR overridden because of divergence
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+4.4% 5y) diverges by >30% from revenue (-2.8% 5y, -7.6% 3y) and EPS (-19.6% 5y). Book value has grown only through retained earnings while the operating business shrank from RMB32.1bn (FY2021) to RMB24.3bn (FY2025) revenue; equity CAGR is not a usable forward growth proxy.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF (OCF before interest paid, less gross PP&E purchases) minus interest income; SBC is nil. Owner-FCF CAGRs (+10.4% 3y, +29.4% 5y) are flattered by the start years: FY2020 FCF was depressed by a working-capital build and FY2023-25 OCF was boosted by working-capital release as revenue fell -- a shrinking manufacturer liberates receivables and inventory. Not a growth signal.

base.narrative: Domestic property drag bottoms in FY2026-27, municipal pipe-network renewal (15th FYP: ~770k km, ~RMB5tn) and overseas bases (12% of revenue, +36% in H1 FY2026) return the group to low-single-digit growth; operating EBITDA margin recovers only partway to ~15.5% (vs 17-21% FY2019-21).

bull.narrative: Scale leader takes share as smaller pipe makers exit an over-capacity market; overseas revenue compounds at 20%+ as the Indonesia/Thailand/Africa/Texas bases fill, and municipal/agricultural demand outruns the residential decline; resin costs stable, so margin returns to ~17.5% (still below the FY2019-20 peak).

bear.narrative: No property inflection: new-build starts keep falling, price war in PVC/PE pipe persists, developer receivables keep producing impairments, and overseas bases stay sub-scale and loss-dilutive; revenue shrinks another ~12% before stabilising and operating EBITDA margin settles at 12.5%.

scenario_narratives.base: China Lesso's revenue has fallen four straight years (RMB32.1bn FY2021 to RMB24.3bn FY2025, H1 FY2026 -4.5%) as the residential property downturn and pipe-industry overcapacity hit volume and price. The base case has FY2026 down ~4% and flat in FY2027, then 2-3% growth as municipal underground-pipe renewal under the 15th Five-Year Plan and the overseas build-out (12.1% of H1 FY2026 revenue, +36%) offset residential weakness. Operating EBITDA margin (ex associates, interest income and fair-value items) recovers from ~14.5% to 15.5%, net capex runs slightly above D&A for the overseas plants, and the cap of 12x terminal FCF binds over Gordon.
scenario_narratives.bull: Consolidation: as the largest Chinese plastic-pipe maker with ~3,200 exclusive first-tier distributors, Lesso takes share from smaller players squeezed out by price competition; overseas distribution grows 20%+ a year and becomes accretive; falling CNY rates keep cutting finance cost. Revenue returns to 5% growth by FY2028 and margin to 17.5% -- still below the 19-21% of FY2019-20.
scenario_narratives.bear: The property 'deep adjustment' runs on: residential starts keep falling, PVC resin swings squeeze a commoditised product, receivable and settlement-property impairments recur, and the overseas plants (Nigeria, Bangladesh, Texas, SE Asia) stay a drag. Revenue falls another ~12% to ~RMB21bn before stabilising, margin settles at 12.5%, and with ~RMB12bn of seasonal-adjusted net debt most of the operating equity disappears; what is left is largely the haircut non-operating assets, which the market already refuses to credit.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: no confirmed property inflection in filings through H1 FY2026, three consecutive years of falling profit, ND/equity 52.8% on a shrinking EBITDA, and a ~69% family-controlled register that makes the non-operating assets hard for minorities to realise. Base 50% as the infrastructure/overseas offset is already visible in H1 FY2026 regional mix. Bull cut to 20% because it needs share gains, overseas profitability and margin recovery to all happen together.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF of the pipe/building-materials operating business in CNY at an 8% CNY WACC, plus a haircut sum-of-parts of the non-operating balance sheet (investment properties at 50%, listed associates Keda and Xingfa marked to market, unlisted associates at 50%, financial assets at 75%), less net debt and NCI, converted to HKD at 1.1724. At HK$3.07 the market values the whole group at roughly the operating DCF alone and gives close to nothing for ~RMB9bn of investment property and ~RMB7bn of associates and financial assets; the base-case upside therefore rests heavily on whether those assets are worth anything to a minority holder of a family-controlled company.
key_risks_to_valuation: Leverage amplifies the operating case: ~RMB12-13bn net debt against an operating EV of ~RMB15-22bn, so each 1pp of EBITDA margin moves equity by a large fraction of the market cap
Investment properties (RMB9.1bn book, ~0.2% rental yield) are carried at 50%; at zero, the base value falls by ~RMB1.46/share (~HK$1.71)
Recurring credit losses on developer/contractor receivables (RMB260m FY2025, RMB547m FY2024) are kept in EBITDA; a developer default wave would exceed that run-rate

Year-1 working-capital sign: a shrinking manufacturer releases cash (FY2023-25 OCF exceeded EBITDA-based expectations); the -5% capture rate on falling revenue credits a small inflow in FY2026 and the bear case
FX: per-share values are CNY converted at 1.1724 HKD/CNY; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate
